verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://svelte.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with "Svelte Documentation for LLMs". Svelte also publishes size-tiered variants (llms-medium.txt, llms-small.txt) and per-section llms.txt files for the CLI, SvelteKit and AI docs, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. The AI docs section further describes an MCP server that feeds documentation to agents. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents successfully consuming these llms.txt files in practice.
